test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 21 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which among the following organisations launched the ‘Scheme for Promoting Registration of Employers and Employees’ (SPREE 2025)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Employees' State Insurance Corporation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC)** launched the **‘Scheme for Promoting Registration of Employers and Employees’ (SPREE 2025)** to enhance the coverage of social security benefits.
 
• The main objective of **SPREE 2025** is to encourage **employers** to register themselves and their **employees** who were previously eligible but remained unregistered under the **ESI Act, 1948**.
 
• The scheme is designed as a **one-time opportunity** for **employers** to come forward and formalize their workforce without the immediate burden of past penalties, thereby promoting **ease of doing business**.
 
• The duration of this scheme is set for **six months**, specifically remaining operational from **October 2024** to **March 2025**.
 
• By registering under this scheme, **employees** gain access to a wide array of **social security** benefits, including comprehensive **medical care** and **cash benefits** during contingencies like sickness or injury.
 
• This initiative is a strategic step by the **Ministry of Labour and Employment** to ensure the **formalization** of the Indian workforce and provide a safety net to those in the organized and semi-organized sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Employees' State Insurance (ESI) Act, 1948:**
 
 
• It was the first major **social security** legislation in independent **India**, designed to provide **health insurance** and **disability benefits** to workers.
 
• The **ESIC** is a **statutory body** established under this Act and functions under the administrative control of the **Ministry of Labour and Employment**, Government of India.
 
 
 
• **Contribution Rates:**
 
 
• The **ESI Scheme** is self-financing, where contributions are made by both the **employer** and the **employee**.
 
• Currently, the **employer's contribution** is **3.25%** and the **employee's contribution** is **0.75%** of the total wages paid.
 
 
 
• **Eligibility Criteria:**
 
 
• The Act applies to **factories** and other establishments like **shops, hotels, restaurants, cinemas,** and **private medical institutions** employing **10 or more** persons.
 
• The current **wage ceiling** for coverage under the **ESI Scheme** is **Rs. 21,000** per month (**Rs. 25,000** for persons with disabilities).
 
 
 
• **Types of Benefits provided by ESIC:**
 
 
• **Medical Benefit:** Full medical care is provided to an **Insured Person** and their family members from the day they enter insurable employment.
 
• **Sickness Benefit:** Periodic payments to any **insured person** in case of sickness certified by a medical practitioner.
 
• **Maternity Benefit:** Payable to **insured women** for confinement or miscarriage, generally for a period of **26 weeks**.
 
• **Disablement Benefit:** Provided to employees who suffer **employment injury** resulting in temporary or permanent disability.
 
• **Dependants' Benefit:** Paid in the form of a **monthly pension** to the dependants of a deceased **Insured Person** in cases where death occurs due to **employment injury** or occupational hazards.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **ESIC** headquarters is located in **New Delhi**, and it manages a vast network of **hospitals** and **dispensaries** across the **country**.
 
• Digital integration through the **Shram Suvidha Portal** and the issuance of **Pehchan Cards** (identity cards) has streamlined the process of availing **cashless medical services**.
 
• The **Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana (ABVKY)** is another significant welfare scheme under **ESIC** that provides **unemployment allowance** to insured persons who have lost their jobs.
